tom_claim_check.note: Tom said old 6.1% recall is ~30% of reachable via R_reachable ≈ old_TP / n_exact_alt. That arithmetic holds: 402/1333 ≈ 30.2%. However that overstates true reachable recall because only 222/402 old TPs are exact_alt (180 are tone/segment/diff changes). True reachable recall = new_TP / n_exact_alt = 222/1333 ≈ 16.7%.
